target.statement: NLLog (WWS + TF-IDF + MiniLM + LGBM) achieves F1 = 97.49% on BGL under the matched protocol (Table 4, full WWS F1).
target.dataset: BGL (Blue Gene/L) log dataset from LogHub

compute.basis: No code released; must reimplement Drain3 parsing, WWS rewriting (481 templates with heuristics/lexical refinements), MiniLM embedding of ~4.7M log lines, TF-IDF pooling, and LGBM training with 5 seeds and 3-fold CV; CPU-only feasible but embedding millions of lines dominates runtime.

blockers: No code or artifact released (paper says package will be submitted only if accepted)

title: NLLog: Lightweight, Explainable SOC Anomaly Detection via Log-to-Language Rewriting
